reviewer: Claude Code (AI assistant) bounded quality inspection. NOT a deployment approval; authorizes no database write.
scope: 110 sampled decisions (59 passing, 51 rejected or unknown) across original status, outcome, name source, extent band, police division and year, plus population-level checks of the full allowlist.
method_calibration: On 2,531 accepted blocks for records Census already matched, the Census point lies a median 6.35 m from the accepted SanGIS block geometry; 95th percentile 52.6 m; 2.65% exceed 100 m. Long (200-400 m) blocks and divided-road clusters show no worse agreement than short single blocks.
sample_findings: Every passing road block had an agreeing police beat, an exact TIGER road name within 30 m, a single City of San Diego cluster and an extent of at most 400 m. The four sampled documented-alias resolutions (BLACK MTN RD, CARMEL MTN RD, MT AGUILAR DR) had the stored Census point 6.2-6.5 m from the SanGIS block. The two sampled official-abbreviation intersections passed Stage C's strict topology and TIGER checks. Rejected samples were correctly rejected: blocks over 400 m, distant duplicate blocks, Census matches to a different street or block, and beat disagreements.
population_checks: Of 542 accepted ambiguous reports, 196 have a documented-equivalent Census point, all within 93 m of the SanGIS block (rule limit 100 m); the other 346 were Census ties without candidate coordinates, resolved only by one unique City block, beat agreement and TIGER name corroboration (never by nearest-candidate choice). 249 allowlisted reports rely on SanGIS' own rd20full abbreviation; they cannot be calibrated against existing matches but each has TIGER full-name corroboration and beat agreement. 795 allowlisted blocks exceed 300 m, so their representative point can be up to about 200 m from the block ends; the uncertainty radius is stored per report.
unresolved_by_design: Spanish street-type abbreviations Census returned (PASEO/PSO, AVENIDA/AVE, CALLE/CLL, CAMINITO/CMT, PLAZA/PLZ) were not accepted as equivalences because no record-level official source pairing was used; those reports remain street_conflict.
conclusion: No systematic false-acceptance pattern was found. The allowlist may proceed to separate human review and explicit, status-specific approval. All coordinates are approximate present-day reference positions.
